title: 🎉 Summarize request.

messages.content:
Your task is to create a storyboard using all four templates provided above while maintaining consistency throughout its structure.

The storyboard will be provided as plain text, with the following sections:

Title: The title of the novel.
Description: A brief summary of the story.
Characters: A list of characters, each with a `name` and a suggested `voice` (e.g., `name: Koiufeofd, voice: en_lkjfhwkjd`).
Plot: A description of the story's plot points, scene by scene. This section might include dialogue suggestions, but short.
Note: (Optional)

It seems like you're excited to start, but I don't see any templates provided. Could you please provide the four templates you'd like me to work with? I'll be happy to help you create a storyboard once I have them.

If you're ready, please go ahead and share the templates, and we can get started on creating an amazing storyboard!
